rows.sentence: Your neighbor is half right: Sec. 3-5 requires bottle clubs in unincorporated areas to close from midnight Saturday until 7:00 a.m. Monday — you must close at midnight on Saturday.
rows.label: supported
rows.rationale: For bottle clubs in unincorporated areas, the section expressly requires closure beginning at midnight Saturday and continuing until 7:00 a.m. Monday.

rows.sentence: On Sunday there is no midnight closing: you may serve until 2:00 a.m. (Sec. 3-3); the club must be closed 3:00–7:00 a.m.
rows.label: contradictory
rows.rationale: The bottle club must already be closed throughout Sunday, so it cannot serve until 2:00 a.m. as claimed.

rows.sentence: Sec. 3-1: applies to unincorporated county areas and municipalities without their own ordinances; violations are a second-degree misdemeanor.
rows.label: supported
rows.rationale: The section applies to unincorporated areas and municipalities without an ordinance covering the same subject, and it classifies violations as second-degree misdemeanors.

rows.sentence: Sec. 3-2: a bottle club sells products known to be mixed with alcoholic beverages for on-premises consumption.
rows.label: unsupported
rows.rationale: The definition does not require a sale or actual mixing: it also covers products dispensed, served, or otherwise provided for consideration and intended to be drunk in connection with alcohol.

rows.sentence: Sec. 3-3 (on-premises): 7:00 a.m.–2:00 a.m. daily; Sunday 11:00 a.m.–2:00 a.m. next day (golf courses, large banquet halls, hotel guest rooms may start 7:00 a.m. Sunday).
rows.label: unsupported
rows.rationale: The general hours match, but the early Sunday exceptions are narrower than stated: they require qualifying licenses, and the banquet-hall exception applies to qualifying private functions, not large halls generally.

rows.sentence: Sec. 3-4 (off-premises): 7:00 a.m.–2:00 a.m.; Sunday 9:00 a.m.–2:00 a.m.
rows.label: supported
rows.rationale: These are the regular and Sunday sales windows specified for licensed off-premises sales.

rows.sentence: Sec. 3-5: bottle clubs closed 3:00–7:00 a.m. daily; closed midnight Saturday to 7:00 a.m. Monday.
rows.label: supported
rows.rationale: The section specifies the ordinary daily closure and the longer weekend closure for bottle clubs in unincorporated areas.
